in_hebrew.name: Billen
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Gift of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Billen הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the biblical name 'Elien', meaning 'God is my light'. Billen represents the divine gift bestowed upon an individual.

in_greek.name: Billen
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Gift of God
in_greek.long_meaning: Billen είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the biblical name 'Elien', meaning 'God is my light'. Billen represents the divine gift bestowed upon an individual.

in_latin.name: Billen
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Gift of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Billen est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the biblical name 'Elien', meaning 'God is my light'. Billen represents the divine gift bestowed upon an individual.
